summary: PARTIAL FIX VERIFIED — REGRESSION NOT FULLY CLOSED. Main agent's iter25 fix to saveConnectTranscriptSessions (try/catch per iteration + meetingId fallback unwrap `meeting?.id || meeting?.meeting_id || meeting?.data?.id` + failures collection + partialFailure propagation to setSaveNotice) IS in place at /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js lines 444-498 and runCombinedAnalysis lines 1125-1140 — verified by code inspection. Functionally the regression is IMPROVED from iter24 (which saved 1-2 of 4) to iter25 (which now saves 3 of 4 successfully), BUT the LAST session in the loop is STILL silently dropped: with 4 transcripts filled (DOM verified at 132/132/136/134 chars), the network shows: POST /meetings #1 → 200 → POST /transcript #1 → 200 (Session 1: 133 char transcript persisted ✓), POST /meetings #2 → 200 → POST /transcript #2 → 200 (Session 2: 132 chars ✓), POST /meetings #3 → 200 → POST /transcript #3 → 200 (Session 3: 136 chars ✓), POST /meetings #4 → 200 (meeting-ab5e7cf1c4 created) → **NO POST /transcript #4 ever fires**. A 5th duplicate POST /meetings hangs without a response, the UI is stuck on 'Analyzing all transcripts...' spinner indefinitely, analyze-all is NEVER called, and the partial-failure summary is NEVER surfaced (failures.length=0 because nothing threw — the loop just stalls). Backend post-run: 4 v3_meetings rows, 3 with non-empty transcripts (Session 1/2/3), 1 with transcript_len=0 (Session 4). After cleanup. Anthropic still returns honest_fallback (out of credits) — acceptable per brief.

ui_bugs.issue: After main agent's try/catch+unwrap fix, the loop NOW successfully iterates through more sessions (3 of 4 transcripts persist with content) BUT the LAST session in the loop is still silently dropped: a duplicate POST /api/v3/meetings is fired for Session 4 and HANGS (no response, no timeout, no rejection), leaving (a) the freshly-created Session 4 meeting with transcript_len=0, (b) the loop suspended forever on `await v3CreateMeeting(...)` of that duplicate, (c) `saveTranscriptSessions` never resolves, (d) `v3AnalyzeAllTranscripts` is never called, (e) the UI is stuck on 'Analyzing all transcripts...' spinner with no error notice. Because no exception was thrown, the new `failures` array stays empty and `savedSessions.partialFailure` is never set — so the user sees NO indication that 1 of 4 transcripts was lost. Suspected root cause: React StrictMode double-invocation of the async save function OR a missing in-flight de-dupe in the Analyze All button's onClick (button is not disabled while saving — clicking it twice or React re-firing the handler restarts the loop while the first is still running). Also possible: `setSaving(true)` causes a re-render that re-runs `runCombinedAnalysis` via stale event handler.

The Analyze All button does NOT appear to be disabled while `saving===true` or `analyzing===true`. Add `disabled={saving || analyzing}` so a rapid double-click or React re-render cannot kick off a parallel save. Also consider an in-flight ref guard inside `runCombinedAnalysis` so concurrent invocations bail.

If a duplicate save is launched in parallel and BOTH iterate over cleanSessions, both will POST /api/v3/meetings for every session — explaining the 'extra' 5th POST observed and the 4 backend meetings for 4 sessions (= 1 per session, despite 4+1 creates being attempted, because one of the parallel loops would 409/race). The 2nd in-flight POST then hangs because the backend route may serialize per business_case_id. Need an in-flight guard.

action_items: CRITICAL: Add in-flight guard to `runCombinedAnalysis` (/app/frontend/src/pages/admin/V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js line 1125). Use a useRef-based lock: `const inFlightRef = useRef(false); if (inFlightRef.current) return; inFlightRef.current = true; try { ... } finally { inFlightRef.current = false; }`. This will prevent React StrictMode double-mount or rapid re-clicks from kicking off a parallel save loop that races itself.
CRITICAL: Disable the connect-analyze-all-btn while `saving || analyzing`. Currently it stays clickable, which is the most likely user-facing trigger for the duplicate POST.

Add a timeout to v3CreateMeeting (and v3UploadMeetingTranscript) at /app/frontend/src/lib/v3api.js — e.g. AbortController with 30s timeout — so a hung request rejects instead of hanging the save loop forever.

Inside saveConnectTranscriptSessions, after the loop, even if failures.length === 0, validate that `savedSessions.length === cleanSessions.length`. If not, push a synthetic failure for the missing indices so the user sees a partial-failure summary instead of silent data loss.

Surface partial-failure in a dedicated red toast (separate from the AnalyzerSourceBanner) so the user does not confuse 'Anthropic out of credits — fallback used' (amber) with 'we dropped one of your transcripts' (red).

Once the in-flight guard ships, re-run the full Playwright regression: fill 4 → save → expect 4 meetings + 4 transcripts in backend, navigate away+return → expect 4 hydrated editors with content, append 5th → save → expect 5+5, reload → still 5 with content, no duplicate creates.
critical_code_review_comments: saveConnectTranscriptSessions try/catch + meetingId unwrap + partialFailure tracking (lines 444-498) is correctly written. The bug is NOT in this function — it is in the CALLER (runCombinedAnalysis) which lacks an in-flight guard, allowing the loop to be launched twice in parallel.

runCombinedAnalysis lines 1125-1140 sets `setAnalyzing(true)` synchronously but does NOT also disable the button at the DOM level (no `disabled={saving || analyzing}` prop on the Analyze All button). A React 18 concurrent re-render can also trigger the click handler twice in dev mode.
v3CreateMeeting (and v3UploadMeetingTranscript) at /app/frontend/src/lib/v3api.js have no client-side timeout — a hung request will keep the save loop alive forever with no user feedback.
V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js still 4184 lines — should be split into /admin/connect/ modules. Carry-over from prior iters.
The Anthropic 'out of credits' fallback is acceptable per brief, but its banner overlaps the saveNotice region, making partial-failure cases harder to spot. Separate the two visually.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (frontend, layered above iter24's fix): The fix to saveConnectTranscriptSessions (try/catch + fallback unwrap of meetingId + failures collection + partialFailure summary) IS correctly implemented at /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/V1BusinessCaseFlowPages.js lines 444-498 and runCombinedAnalysis surfaces partialFailure at lines 1131-1133/1137-1140. With this fix, 3 of 4 sessions now persist correctly (vs 1-2 of 4 in iter24). The remaining failure is in the CALLER: runCombinedAnalysis (line 1125) and the Analyze All button have NO in-flight guard. The button is not `disabled={saving || analyzing}`, and `runCombinedAnalysis` does not use a useRef-based lock. Result: a duplicate invocation (either from React 18 StrictMode dev double-invoke, a rapid re-click, or React concurrent re-render firing the handler twice) launches a SECOND save loop in parallel with the first. The second loop's `POST /api/v3/meetings` for Session 4 races against the first loop's same POST, and the backend (or the proxy in front of it) appears to serialize / hang the second request — it never resolves, never rejects. The first loop's iter 4 completes its create (meeting-ab5e7cf1c4) but its subsequent `await v3UploadMeetingTranscript(...)` is also blocked behind the hung 2nd-loop POST (or the await chain is blocked because the OUTER loop is awaiting in two concurrent stacks). Net result: 3 transcripts persist with content + 1 empty meeting + 1 hung XHR + saveTranscriptSessions never returns + analyze-all never fires + UI stuck on 'Analyzing all transcripts...' spinner + no error toast (because no exception was thrown — the await just never settles). REPRODUCTION: (1) auth via demo-login + localStorage seed, (2) goto /admin/business-cases/bc-472329ed4c/connect/schedule, (3) add 3 transcripts (4 total) via connect-add-transcript-btn, (4) fill each via locator.fill(content) with 150ms gaps + 1500ms settle, (5) click connect-analyze-all-btn ONCE, (6) capture page.on('request') / page.on('response') for /api/v3/* POSTs, (7) wait 70s for networkidle, (8) observe: 4 POST /meetings (only 3 with responses), 3 POST /transcript (all 200), 0 POST /analyze-all, UI spinner still active. Backend check: 4 v3_meetings rows on bc, 3 with content + 1 empty. MITIGATION: (a) add `disabled={saving || analyzing}` to the Analyze All button JSX, (b) wrap runCombinedAnalysis in a useRef-based lock (`const inFlightRef = useRef(false); if (inFlightRef.current) return; inFlightRef.current = true; try { ... } finally { inFlightRef.current = false; }`), (c) add AbortController/30s timeout to v3CreateMeeting and v3UploadMeetingTranscript so any hung XHR rejects into the try/catch instead of stalling the loop, (d) after the loop, if savedSessions.length !== cleanSessions.length, synthesize failures so the partial-failure UI banner always fires on data loss, (e) consider separating the partial-failure toast from the AnalyzerSourceBanner so the user sees BOTH cleanly (red toast 'Saved 3 of 4; 1 failed' vs amber inline 'AI analyser offline').
